insights.headline: US Treasury yield hits the Highest Since 2002 at 5.34%
insights.reasoning: A surge in US 10-year Treasury yields to multi-decade highs sharply increases the global risk-free rate, accelerating Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) outflows from emerging markets like India. This sustained capital flight intensifies selling pressure on headline benchmark indices and strains domestic currency valuation. The higher cost of capital globally also dampens risk sentiment across equity markets.
